blocker.error_root: rm: cannot remove '.../sandbox-skills/skills': Device or resource busy (it is a bind-mount)
blocker.diagnosis: alpine/openclaw:latest seeds sandbox-skills as a root-owned bind-mount in the workspace, then its own prep step rm's it and fails regardless of user. Upstream OpenClaw/benchmark bug under this Docker/WSL setup, NOT an H1M or config issue.
blocker.disable_flag: none — openclaw run/agent expose no skills/sandbox-disable flag
blocker.rm_location: inside the OpenClaw gateway container (GatewayClientRequestError) — i.e. in DendriteHQ's alpine/openclaw image, not patchable without rebuilding it
blocker.native_docker_test: SAME error 'rm sandbox-skills/skills: Device or resource busy' -> NOT a Docker Desktop issue
blocker.common_factor: WSL2 itself (kernel 6.18.33.1-microsoft-standard-WSL2) — its mount-namespace/propagation under Docker-in-Docker leaves OpenClaw's skills bind-mount un-removable; OR an OpenClaw/benchmark version regression (2 versions failed identically -> less likely).
